title: VEO Video Creator Input Schema
description: Complete input specification for creating professional videos optimized for Google Veo 3.1 with native audio, multi-character dialogue, and cinematic composition

description.title: 1. Video Description
description.description: Describe the video scene, action, characters, and mood. Can be in Thai or English — the AI will transform it into an optimized Veo 3.1 prompt.
examples: Thai male host introducing himself in a studio, speaking Thai
Aerial drone shot over Bangkok at golden hour
Two people interview in an office, discussing technology
Night market scene with multiple camera angles
Product showcase of a luxury watch on black velvet

duration.title: 2. Clip Duration (seconds)
duration.description: Duration per clip. Must be 8s when using 1080p/4K or reference images.

aspectRatio.title: 3. Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Video aspect ratio. Affects composition and framing.

enumDescriptions.9:16: Vertical — TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts

enumDescriptions.720p: 720p — Faster generation, supports 4/6/8s duration, required for extension
enumDescriptions.1080p: 1080p — High quality, 8s only, longer generation time
enumDescriptions.4k: 4K — Ultra high quality, 8s only, longest generation time

style.title: 5. Visual Style
style.description: Overall cinematic style that determines lighting, color, and camera approach

enumDescriptions.cinematic: Film-quality with dramatic lighting and deliberate camera work
enumDescriptions.documentary: Natural lighting, observational camera, authentic feel
enumDescriptions.commercial: High-key lighting, vibrant colors, smooth camera moves
enumDescriptions.music_video: Neon/colored lighting, high contrast, dynamic camera
enumDescriptions.vlog: Natural window light, warm tones, slight handheld feel
enumDescriptions.film_noir: Hard shadows, high contrast, moody atmosphere
enumDescriptions.anime: Stylized flat lighting, vibrant saturated colors
enumDescriptions.artistic: Experimental lighting, bold palette, creative framing

audioMode.title: 6. Audio Mode
audioMode.description: Type of audio to generate with the video

enumDescriptions.full_mix: Dialogue + SFX + Ambient — Complete sound design (Recommended)
enumDescriptions.sfx_only: Sound effects only, no speech or ambient

dialogueLanguage.title: 7. Dialogue Language
dialogueLanguage.description: Language for spoken dialogue / voiceover in the video

speakerCount.title: 8. Number of Speakers
speakerCount.description: Number of speaking characters. 0 = no dialogue (B-roll/ambient). Affects framing and blocking.

speakerDetails.title: 9. Speaker Details (Optional)
speakerDetails.description: Describe each speaker's appearance, name, and role. Separate multiple speakers with |. Example: 'Host: Thai male, 30s, blazer | Guest: Thai female, 25s, casual dress'
examples: Host: Thai male, early 30s, short hair, navy blazer
Host: Thai male, 30s, blazer | Guest: Thai female, 25s, casual dress
Person A: project lead, stands near whiteboard | Person B: designer, seated | Person C: editor, seated

dialogueScript.title: 10. Dialogue Script (Optional)
dialogueScript.description: Pre-written dialogue for speakers. Format: 'Speaker: dialogue text'. Separate lines with |. Leave empty for AI-generated dialogue.
examples: Host: Hello everyone, today we will cover 3 video techniques
Host: What do you think about this? | Guest: I think it's very interesting
Narrator: When the city never stops moving

shotType.title: 11. Shot Type
shotType.description: Camera framing / shot size. Auto-selected if not specified.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content and speaker count
enumDescriptions.extreme_wide: Extreme wide shot — Establishing shot, landscapes
enumDescriptions.wide: Wide shot — Full body, environment context
enumDescriptions.medium_wide: Medium wide shot — Knee-up, walking scenes
enumDescriptions.extreme_close_up: Extreme close-up — Eyes, small details, macro
enumDescriptions.two_shot: Two-shot — Two people in frame, interviews

cameraMovement.title: 12. Camera Movement
cameraMovement.description: Camera motion style. Auto-selected if not specified.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content and style
enumDescriptions.rack_focus: Rack focus — Shift focus between subjects

lighting.title: 13. Lighting Style
lighting.description: Lighting approach. Auto-selected based on style if not specified.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on style and mood

mood.title: 14. Mood / Atmosphere
mood.description: Emotional tone of the scene. Affects color grading, pacing, and audio.

enumDescriptions.futuristic_tech: Blue/cyan tones, clean lines, tech aesthetic

useReferenceImages.title: 15. Use Reference Images
useReferenceImages.description: Enable character locking via reference images (up to 3). Forces 8s duration. Preserves character appearance across clips.

sceneMode.title: 16. Scene Mode
sceneMode.description: How to structure the video output

enumDescriptions.storyboard: Multi-scene storyboard — Multiple clips with transition notes
enumDescriptions.extension: Extension mode — Continue/extend an existing clip

totalScenes.title: 17. Total Scenes (for storyboard mode)
totalScenes.description: Number of scenes in storyboard mode. Each scene is one Veo generation.

useTimestamps.title: 18. Use Timestamp Prompting
useTimestamps.description: Enable multi-shot timestamp blocks within a single clip (e.g., [00:00-00:02] wide shot... [00:02-00:04] close-up...)

voiceTone.title: 19. Voice / Speech Tone
voiceTone.description: Tone descriptor for dialogue or voiceover delivery

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on content and style

colorPalette.title: 20. Color Palette / Grading
colorPalette.description: Color grading approach for the video. Affects overall tone and feel.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on style and mood
enumDescriptions.warm_amber: Warm amber and orange tones — cozy, inviting
enumDescriptions.cool_blue: Cool blue and gray tones — professional, clean
enumDescriptions.teal_orange: Teal shadows + orange highlights — cinematic blockbuster look
enumDescriptions.desaturated: Muted, low saturation — serious, documentary feel
enumDescriptions.pastel_soft: Soft pastel tones — dreamy, gentle, romantic
enumDescriptions.monochrome: Black and white or near-monochrome — artistic, noir
enumDescriptions.neon_cyberpunk: Neon pink, cyan, purple — futuristic, nightlife
enumDescriptions.earthy_natural: Greens, browns, warm neutrals — organic, nature
enumDescriptions.vintage_film: Faded highlights, lifted blacks, film grain — retro analog

depthOfField.title: 21. Depth of Field
depthOfField.description: Control the focus depth — affects background blur and cinematic feel.

enumDescriptions.auto: Auto-select based on shot type and style
enumDescriptions.deep: Deep focus — everything sharp, front to back (landscapes, wide shots)
enumDescriptions.shallow: Shallow DOF — subject sharp, background softly blurred (portraits, interviews)
enumDescriptions.ultra_shallow: Ultra-shallow — extreme bokeh, dreamy separation (close-ups, products)
enumDescriptions.rack_focus: Rack focus — shift focus between foreground and background during shot

negativeElements.title: 22. Elements to Avoid (Optional)
negativeElements.description: List elements to avoid in generation (not as negative prompt, but as guidance). E.g., 'text overlays, watermarks, split screen'
